goals.name: Improve Sales Performance Engagement — Work with Jeff (Northwood)
goals.assessment: Green — weekly Trinity/Northwood sync continuing. 9/23–9/24 two-day call grade (sent to Jeff Friday via Monday + Slack) showed real movement: Open 23%→56%, Their Concerns 23%→68% week-over-week — reps are asking the concerns question but not staying in it long enough (Tetet: rapport zone held under 20 sec). This week's training focus: Active Listening via role play (main session + daily-huddle mini-drills). Team homework: each rep submits their own best active-listening call as a benchmark, against the team's 80%-per-item target. Concern-handling approach changed by Jeff, a real shift from prior training: reps now only acknowledge concerns during Open/Concerns ("noted") and hold all promise-based responses (damage coverage, on-time guarantee) until the Two Promises step after the estimate — replacing the old in-the-moment-response rule; concerns not covered by either promise are deferred to next week's training. Coordination friction this cycle: Jeff was unaware Friday's call-grade send had landed until confirmed live on the call; Jeff also showed up with a redone script Amanda had to walk him through against the version her team sent Friday — script version reconciliation now explicitly assigned to Jeff (official V2 incoming). The v3 CET rubric rollout (see Goal 1) also resolves the run-reliability blocker previously listed here.
